about_disease.description: Sickle cell anemias are chronic hemolytic diseases that may induce three types of acute accidents: severe anemia, severe bacterial infections, and ischemic vasoocclusive accidents (VOA) caused by sickle-shaped red blood cells obstructing small blood vessels and capillaries. Many diverse complications can occur.
also_called: sickling disorder due to Haemoglobin S

Hereditary hemoglobinopathy disorder homozygous for hemoglobin S
